title: The singleton distinguished fibre of a strict henselization
statement: Let S be a scheme, Omega an algebraically closed field and s:Spec Omega to S a geometric point. Let A be a commutative local ring and e:Spec A isomorphic to S_(s). For every x in Spec A, the structural image rho_s(e(x)) equals s(closedPoint Omega) if and only if x=closedPoint A. Here S_(s) and rho_s are [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] and [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. No henselianity or residue separable-closedness assumption on A is needed.

source.place: Tags 04GW and 04GP; Etale Cohomology Tag 04HX identifies the neighbourhood colimit

proof.text: Choose an affine chart Spec R of the image p of s. Identify the coordinate-ring colimit over pointed affine neighbourhoods with the etale residue-triple colimit for R, p and the relative separable closure in Omega. Localizing a neighbourhood at its selected prime leaves the colimit unchanged, since elements outside the prime are inverted on smaller pointed opens. The small-model and affine-presentation comparisons preserve every coordinate-ring coprojection and the structural map.

The triple colimit is local, its maximal ideal is p extended to the colimit, and its quotient is the selected separable closure. Thus primes mapping to p are exactly the maximal ideal: they contain pC, which is maximal; conversely that maximal ideal contracts to p. This gives a singleton structural fibre, including its image equation.

Transport the singleton fibre through e. An isomorphism of spectra preserves closed points. A local ring has a unique closed point, so the transported maximal ideal is IsLocalRing.closedPoint A. The result is unchanged in the field case, where that closed point is zero.

theorem strictHenselizationStructuralMap_fiber_eq_closedPoint
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω A : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (e : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s)
    (x : Spec (.of A)) :
    (e.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) x = s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ↔
      x = IsLocalRing.closedPoint A
